text:
elaine: deploy-bot just flagged eu-dedicated canary p95 +210ms during change window.

deploy-bot: alert: canary.p95=730ms (+210ms) over 5m; client_err_rate +2.1%. Suggested: PAUSE rollout. auto-rollback disabled (change-window).

tom: Which commits are in this batch? I see a kernel selector toggle + a telemetry agent bump.

chris: kernel selector + small cache tweak. Local perf looked fine but we skipped multi-az canary.

ops_oncall: With auto-rollback off we need manual mitigation. Recommend 50/50 traffic split back to prior stable and pin canary for investigation.

elaine: Agree. Also loop legal if we notify early-access customers.

deploy-bot: CLI hints:
`redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --route default --split 50:50 --to v2.3.12,v2.4.7`
`redwood pin --instance canary-eu --version v2.4.7`

tom: Applying split now.

deploy-bot: action started (requested by tom). rollout id: r-640000-01

tom: applied. monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/eu-dedicated/r-640000-01

chris: tailing logs: errors and `cuda_sync_timeout` occurrences concentrated on v2.4.7.

elaine: Draft to EA customers: "We've detected a latency regression during canary. We've partially routed traffic to prior stable while we investigate. No data loss expected. Ops contact attached." @legal please review.

legal: quick review: wording OK; avoid SLA guarantees.

chris: I'll open a cherry-pick revert for the kernel selector and run canary-only redeploy on CI green.

ops_oncall: +10m update: overall p95 down to ~500ms; v2.3.12 ~490ms; v2.4.7 ~720ms. Keeping 50/50 until revert validated.

elaine: Checklist: [x] split applied [x] customers notified [ ] revert PR + canary redeploy [ ] post-mortem if unresolved in 2h.

deploy-bot: canary redeploy scheduled after PR merge; health checks will gate promotion. auto-rollback remains suppressed.

tom: Monitoring; will post another update at +30m.

elaine: Closing thread for now; reopen if metrics regress. :thumbsup:
